name: Greenheck SQ Mixed Flow inline fan
summary: Square inline mixed-flow fan family with its own 3D model and Revit family.
description: Coordinate the fan casing and straight duct connections while preserving access to the motor and removable service panels. Match the selected size to the supplied dimensional drawing.
The downloadable GA illustration is independently authored conceptual geometry, with no scale or manufacturer dimensions. Use the official CAD source for the exact layout.
readingNotes: Use the SQ Mixed Flow model and type catalogue; the ordinary SQ model is a separate source.
A common square casing form does not establish interchangeability between standard and mixed-flow variants.
drawingChecklist: Select the Revit type or dimensional size.
Check airflow direction and duct interfaces.
